name: YUKIMARU
source:
Katsurou's fellow host. Although he's still considered a rookie, it's been a year since his debut and he seems to have the potential to get promoted to junior. He hunts for potential princesses through dating apps, and earns a lot from doing "Pillow Business".

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/05/24/sini/]official website[/url]]
